title: Conjectures of Ashoke Sen: Scope, Exact Tests and Analytic Limits
description: The paper examines thirty-six statements associated with Ashoke Sen's work on duality, tachyon condensation, black hole indices and string field theory, separating mathematical results within a stated framework, physical conjectures, and extensions beyond the hypotheses of a derivation. Exact product expansions reproduce the negative full dyon indices of the toroidal orbifolds, with thirty negative-index charge triples in the scanned cone; the dust equations of tachyon matter receive their characteristic flow and sign criterion; the D7 divisor on the F-theory base is separated from its singular pullback to the orientifold cover. The archive holds the compiled paper, its LaTeX source, the exact-arithmetic program that computes every table, the Lean 4 certificates of the finite statements, and the scripts that check the explicit constants of the appendices.
